rules.when: a worker runs on this runtime
rules.why: Kimi renders no trust dialog for a launch, so the gate is never consulted for it. A plain Enter submits. Its composer is a bordered box, which the shared shape reader recognises without a harness name. One Escape cancels the turn. Its composer was never observed after a cancel, so no clear key is claimed and the next submit re-checks the composer before typing. A relaunch cannot resume an exact session, so it starts fresh. While a turn runs the pane draws an anchored moon-phase spinner with a separator and rotating tip text, and idle it draws a status bar whose label is not a busy signal. Busy is read from its hooks, and a build with neither hook source reports unverified instead.
